evidence_excerpts: If the “callosum-like” connections are removed, the main complex breaks down into two smaller complexes, each of which still has a high value of Φ.
If the “auditory” module is functionally disconnected from the rest, the main complex includes just the “supramodal” and “visual” modules.
text: Anatomical or functional disconnection within thalamocortical systems can reduce, split, or selectively alter consciousness by changing the system’s integrated-information structure.
